items.detail: SEARCH_EMPTY still appears despite instruction. Current gate rejects it; original response retained.
qoq_adjacent is absent; text says 바로 이어지는 분기가 아닙니다. Not a new human truth label.
근거가 없는 것이 아니라 ... 근거는 있습니다 is an assertion that evidence exists. Narrow negation allowlist misses 것이 아니라 and rejects prose_evidence_presence_consistent.

2025년 3분기 대비 2024년 3분기 ... -20.5146% reverses the natural-language current/base direction. Tool current is2025 and base2024. Numeric value matches the tool; automatic gate passes. Human review required.
Text now says 별도 재계산 기준 for months/start date diagnostics; b must assess whether wording distinguishes this from tool execution history.
COMPANY_MISMATCH and PERIOD_MISMATCH remain. Current language rule targets SEARCH_EMPTY/qoq_adjacent, not all possible issue labels.
